description_en: A topic is the smallest unit for subscription and publishing in DataHub. You can use a topic to represent a type or category of streaming data
description_zh: Topic是 DataHub 订阅和发布的最小单位，用户可以用Topic来表示一类或者一种流数据
kebab_example: aliyun datahub create-topic --project-name xiaowutest --topic-name adsb_cat021 --shard-count 10 --lifecycle 1 --record-type TUPLE --comment Test --api-version 2024-06-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTopic

parameters.help_en: The lifecycle of the topic. Unit: days
parameters.name: lifecycle

parameters.help_en:
The type of the topic. Valid values:

Blob: supports writing a block of binary data as a single record.

Tuple: supports database-like records where each record contains multiple columns. You must specify a RecordSchema because data is transmitted over the network as strings and requires a schema to convert values to the corresponding types
parameters.help_zh:
Topic类型，目前支持Tuple与Blob两种类型：

Blob类型Topic支持写入一块二进制数据作为一个Record。

Tuple类型的Topic支持类似于数据库的记录的数据，每条记录包含多个列，需要指定RecordSchema，因为网络传输中，数据都是以字符串的形式发送，需要schema来转换成对应的类型
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en: The expansion mode of the topic. After the expansion mode is enabled, shards support horizontal scaling and no longer support merge or split operations. The number of shards can only increase and cannot decrease. After this mode is enabled, you can use the Kafka method to consume the current topic
parameters.help_zh: Topic扩展模式，开启扩展模式后，shard支持水平扩展，不再支持“合并”和“分裂”，以后shard数量只能增加，不可减少。此模式开启后可以使用kafka方式来消费当前Topic
parameters.name: expand_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable multi-version schema. After this feature is enabled, a topic can have multiple schemas simultaneously. You can select one schema for writing. The consumer automatically parses each record based on the version marked on the data. If the schema of the corresponding version is deleted, parsing fails.


Enabling multi-version schema has the following impacts:  
You can no longer use the appendFields operation.
You can create, delete, modify, and query schemas.
Creating a connector uses the schema of the latest version
parameters.help_zh:
开启多version的schema，topic可以同时拥有多个schema，可以选择其中一个schema写入，消费端会根据每条数据标记的version自适应完成解析（如对应的version的schema被删除则解析失败）


开启多version后会有以下影响  
1.用户无法再使用appendFields接口、
 2.可以对schema进行增删改查、
 3.创建Connector使用最新version的schema
parameters.name: enable_schema_registry

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
